_readme: Level 1 objectives: shown one step at a time in the HUD tracker (top center) and in full on the Notes paper.
Each objective is a main objective (big checkbox) with ordered steps (small checkboxes). Order = the order the player should do them.
A step is DONE when its 'trigger' happens. The current step is the first step that is not done.
'progress' (optional): "profiles" shows the live taxpayer-profile counter, e.g. (2/4).
'undoneBy' (optional): a trigger that unchecks the step again, e.g. the case folder coming back after a failed audit.
Edit text, order, steps or objectives freely; changes apply on the next Play. Invalid steps are skipped with a Console warning; if nothing is valid, a built-in copy of this list is used.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
_triggers: event:ProfileCollected        any taxpayer profile was collected
event:TutorialGuideAppeared   the tutorial guide appeared in the plaza
event:TutorialGuideTalkedTo   the guide's talk finished and the corkboard side quest opened
event:SideQuestCompleted      the corkboard side quest was solved
event:CaseFolderOpened        the case folder was opened
event:TaxCodeBookOpened       the Tax Code Book was opened for the first time
event:TaxReturnCollected      the printed tax return was collected
event:CaseCompleted           the case was completed (Auditor approved)
event:ClientCopyPickedUp      the approved client copy was picked up beside the Auditor (story runs)
event:ClientCopyHandedOver    the client copy was handed to the client and the follow-through saved
event:CaseFolderStored        the desk case folder was dragged into the HUD folder icon (count 0 -> 1)
event:CaseFolderReturned      the case folder came back out of the HUD icon (failed audit / new case)
area:<scene path>             the player is inside that object's area; only checked while it is the current step; join several paths with |

state:<game state>            the game entered that state, e.g. state:ReviewDocumentsState, state:AnalyzeEvidenceState, state:StampAssessmentState, state:ComplianceAuditState, state:AuditSubmittedState, state:CaseCompleteState

steps.text: Explore the plaza and talk to the 4 clients to get their taxpayer profiles.
Talk to Arthur, the tutorial guide.
Finish Side Quest 1 at the corkboard.
Go to the main office room, finish the tax case and drag the case folder to your folder icon.
Submit the case folder to the Auditor in his office.
Pick up Marie's client copy from the Auditor.
